facts.fact: The Data Landscapers cable factsheet lists EASSy as in service (ready for service 2010, WIOCC-led consortium) with a landing at Port Sudan, Sudan.
The factsheet marks EASSy open_access yes, with capacity held by a 16+ member consortium led by WIOCC (about 29%); the factsheet is AI-compiled and flags its figures as needing primary checks.

note: Other cables in the factsheet do not name Sudan as a landing.
